title: A rule test fails on a path or command named in instruction files that does not exist
body:
Why: operator-shared trending triage 2026-11-14: google/elephant-goldfish-model drift report (docs compared with code). KRN instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .agents/skills/**, docs/program/*.md) name paths and `krn`/`npm run` commands; a renamed path or retired command keeps misleading agents (see t-31exd5c).
Outcome: a rule test lists every repository path and every `krn <command>` / `npm run <script>` named in those files and fails naming each one that does not exist (paths under .krn/ and placeholders like <id> exempt).
Proof: the rule test red on a fixture line naming a missing path and a retired command, green on the repository. npm run fast PASS.
Scope: test/rules/, the instruction files it fixes.
